name: The High Chieftain
summary: Cairne Bloodhoof’s son sends you to Thunder Bluff to seek his father’s audience. Your defense of your people has earned recognition.

sections.title: A Chieftain’s Deed
sections.body: Cairne Bloodhoof and the young Warchief Thrall led the effort to reclaim these plains from the centaurs. As High Chieftain, Cairne can recognize your part in defending your people.

faq.q: Who am I being sent to see?
faq.answer: You are being sent to seek an audience with Cairne Bloodhoof, the High Chieftain of Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Why am I going to Thunder Bluff?
faq.answer: Your courage in defending your people has earned recognition. So you are asked to seek an audience with Cairne Bloodhoof.
Cairne Bloodhoof and the young Warchief Thrall led the effort to reclaim the plains from the centaurs.
Cairne Bloodhoof is on Thunder Bluff’s central rise.

angles.text: As a tauren, you are sent to Cairne Bloodhoof after defending your people. He and Thrall led the effort to reclaim the plains.

attribution: In-game quest text: The High Chieftain
